item.title: Reality Fracture draft primer
item.description: What 800 simulated drafts and 100,000 games say about the format before release, now that the spoiler is complete and every card in the set is simulated. Red-green is the best pair and blue-black the one to avoid. Choose to play first, and watch for the Garruks and Overwrite the Multiverse going late.
